description: Java class 'AudioOutputManager' managing audio output devices, creating/destroying AudioTrackBridge instances, handling volume updates, and querying device info within an Android media application.

classes.name: AudioOutputManager.OutputDeviceInfo
classes.description: Data class to hold audio device type and channel count info for native communication.

methods.name: AudioOutputManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing context and list of AudioTrackBridge objects.

methods.name: onUpdateVolume
methods.description: Updates volume for all managed AudioTrackBridge instances.

methods.name: createAudioTrackBridge
methods.description: Creates an AudioTrackBridge, registers audio device callback if needed, and adds it to the list.

methods.name: destroyAudioTrackBridge
methods.description: Releases and removes an AudioTrackBridge from the list.

methods.name: getOutputDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves info about a specific output device by index.

methods.name: getMinBufferSize
methods.description: Returns minimum buffer size for given sample type, sample rate, and channel count.

methods.name: generateTunnelModeAudioSessionId
methods.description: Generates an audio session ID for tunneled playback, with compatibility checks.

methods.name: hasPassthroughSupportFor
methods.description: Checks if passthrough is supported for a specific audio encoding.

methods.name: hasPassthroughSupportForV23
methods.description: Checks passthrough support for API 23+ devices.

methods.name: hasDirectSurroundPlaybackSupportForV29
methods.description: Checks if direct surround playback is supported for API 29+.

methods.name: getPassthroughAudioFormatFor
methods.description: Creates an AudioFormat for passthrough with specified encoding and sample rate.

methods.name: getDefaultAudioAttributes
methods.description: Provides default AudioAttributes for media playback.

methods.name: getAndResetHasAudioDeviceChanged
methods.description: Retrieves and resets the flag indicating if audio device has changed.

methods.name: addAudioDeviceListener
methods.description: Registers a static callback for audio device changes if not already registered.
